purpose.summary: Purchase a second refrigerator and Diwali inventory
purpose.reasoning: Adding cold storage for dairy and drinks typically increases high-frequency footfall and margin, making the owner's estimate of ₹6,000 realistic.

reasons.text: Excellent stability with 11 years in business and a well-established shopfront.
Strong financial discipline with a daily ledger kept for 100% of days and perfect bill payment history.
Healthy monthly surplus of ₹22,086 comfortably covers the proposed instalment of ₹7,565.
High digital sales mix at 59% provides verifiable proof of the ₹4,20,000 monthly turnover.
Low customer credit risk with only ₹4,500 outstanding, showing tight control over cash flow.

data.explanationLocal: नमस्ते सुनीता जी, आपकी दुकान का 11 वर्षों का अनुभव और हिसाब-किताब रखने का तरीका बहुत प्रभावशाली है। आपके अच्छे रिकॉर्ड्स के आधार पर, आपकी दुकान ₹80,000 तक के ऋण के लिए योग्य है। यह राशि आपके नए फ्रिज और दिवाली के स्टॉक की योजना में बहुत मददगार होगी। हम आपके व्यापार की प्रगति की सराहना करते हैं।
data.explanationEnglish: Hello Sunita ji, your 11 years of experience and the disciplined way you maintain your records are very impressive. Based on your strong documentation, your shop qualifies for an offer of up to ₹80,000. This amount should comfortably support your plan to buy a new fridge and stock up for Diwali. We truly value the stability of your business.
